architecture: MobileNetV2 (ImageNet, i ngrire) -> concat(GlobalAvgPool, GlobalMaxPool) -> Dropout(0.35) -> Dense(1, sigmoid, L2 1e-4)
augmentation: 2 pamje te augmentuara per foto: flip horizontal+vertikal, rrotullim 0.08, shkelqim/kontrast 0.25
selection_rule: Mesatarja e saktesise per klase mbi grupet e validimit, prag 0.5. test_final nuk u perdor ne asnje moment.
limitation: Development validation is used for checkpoint selection, not an independent test. Correlated frames and shared recordings limit generalization claims. Consult the data preparation report for the selected split.
